gloss: to tilt, to incline, to devote

definitions.gloss: to tilt, to incline, to lean
definitions.explanation: To slant or angle something from its upright position.
To dedicate one's energy, attention, or resources wholeheartedly to something.

examples.japanese: グラスを{傾|かたむ}けてワインを{飲|の}む。
examples.english: Tilt the glass and drink the wine.

examples.japanese: {傘|かさ}を{風|かぜ}の{方|ほう}に{傾|かたむ}けて{歩|ある}いた。
examples.english: I walked tilting my umbrella toward the wind.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{研究|けんきゅう}に{情熱|じょうねつ}を{傾|かたむ}けた。
examples.english: He devoted his passion to research.

examples.japanese: {全力|ぜんりょく}を{傾|かたむ}けてこのプロジェクトに{取|と}り{組|く}んでいます。
examples.english: I am pouring all my energy into this project.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{首|くび}を{傾|かたむ}ける (tilt one's head — often expressing puzzlement)
・{耳|みみ}を{傾|かたむ}ける (listen attentively)
・{情熱|じょうねつ}を{傾|かたむ}ける (devote one's passion)
・{全力|ぜんりょく}を{傾|かたむ}ける (pour all one's efforts)
・グラスを{傾|かたむ}ける (raise/tilt a glass — implies drinking)

The phrase {耳|みみ}を{傾|かたむ}ける is a set expression meaning to listen carefully or pay attention to someone's words.
